side_quests.name: The Lost Ledger
side_quests.description: Three pages from the Grand Ledger have gone missing. Without them, nothing in this region balances.

banter_triggers.line: Wizard: 'I've seen this before.' Sorceres: 'You've seen everything before.' Wizard: 'That's not— okay, yes.'
Rogue: 'These trees are judging us.' Wizard: 'They're always judging. It's their thing.'
Warrior: 'I could just smash through the queue.' Sorceres: 'Please don't. We'd have to fill out the forms.'

guidebook_entries.title: On the Nature of Prophecies
guidebook_entries.text: Prophecies are living documents. They revise themselves when no one is looking. Do not read your prophecy in a mirror.

guidebook_entries.title: Filing Systems
guidebook_entries.text: There are three systems: alphabetical, chronological, and 'wherever there's space.' The third is most common.

guidebook_entries.title: Amendment Protocol
guidebook_entries.text: When an amendment conflicts with the original text, the amendment wins. When two amendments conflict, the most recent wins. When all amendments conflict, see your local bureaucrat.

guidebook_entries.title: Department of Previous Failures
guidebook_entries.text: Not a punishment. A memorial. The plaques here honor those who tried. That they failed is less important than that they filed the paperwork.

guidebook_entries.title: The Talking Trees
guidebook_entries.text: The trees in the Forest of Unhelpful Trees were once memos. They were never delivered. Now they judge everyone who passes.

guidebook_entries.title: Paper Elementals
guidebook_entries.text: Born from forgotten forms. They grow stronger the longer a document goes unfiled. Stamp early, stamp often.

guidebook_entries.title: Compliance Officers
guidebook_entries.text: They are not evil. They are paperwork given form. They will inspect you first. Always have your permits ready.

guidebook_entries.title: The Binder
guidebook_entries.text: Your Prophecy Binder will get heavier. This is normal. The words accumulate. The amendments multiply. Carry it anyway.

idle_lines: Form 12-B is for emergencies only. This is not an emergency.
The line moves when it moves.
No, I cannot 'just skip' the waiting period.
Your amendment is in processing. It will be ready never.
amendment_delivery: This just came through. Prophecy 47-B (Revised) is now 47-B (Revised Again).
New amendment. All prophecies must be filed in triplicate.
Revision 47-B-2: The Chosen One shall carry the binder with both hands.
Urgent memo: All forests now require Form 9-F (Forest Entry Permit).
post_amendment: The paperwork has been updated. Please acknowledge receipt.
Your prophecy is now longer. Congratulations.

mira_shopkeeper: Ink's fresh. Paper's fresh. You're... here. That's something.
Buy something or keep walking. Both help the economy.
The forest path is free. The city gate costs 3 stamps.
aldric_guard: Nothing happens here. That's why I took this post.
If you see anything suspicious, file a report. In triplicate.
Quietvale. Quiet vale. Very quiet. Suspiciously quiet.
bertram_farmer: My crops grew wrong this year. All paperwork-related issues.
The soil needs Form 7-A. I don't have Form 7-A.
The Bureaucrat came by. Said my turnips were 'unauthorized.'
pip_gossip: Did you hear? The Bureaucrat's binder fell open. Pages everywhere!
There's a rumor about Prophecy 47-C. But rumors aren't documented, so they don't count.
I know something about everyone. It's my job. And also my hobby.
lyra_questgiver: Three scouts lost this month. Officially. Unofficially, I'm out of explanations.
The ruins aren't a tourist destination. People die there.
I don't believe in fate. I believe in preparation.
sister_wren: Rest here. The beds are clean and the prophecy-binding doesn't hurt.
You look tired. The prophecy is heavy. I have tea for that.
The Goddess watches. But mostly she naps. Don't tell anyone I said that.
kael_blacksmith: Steel needs form. Form needs filing. Everything needs something.
I forged a sword once. Now I forge permits. Less exciting, more stable.
Your weapon looks dull. Or maybe that's just bureaucracy.
dolly_innkeeper: Welcome to the Quietvale Inn. No lurgy, no prophecy, just sleep.
If the Bureaucrat comes looking, I haven't seen you.
Rooms are 5 stamps a night. Cheaper if you have a permit.
aldous_priest: The Goddess is eternal. Her paperwork is also eternal.
Blessings are free. Curses require Form 13-C.
I've been a priest for thirty years. The bureaucracy never changes.
jasper_bard: ♪ The Chosen One went to file / And stayed a little while / The forms were many / The patience thin / But the prophecy pulled them in ♪
I sing for stamps. Not stamps as in 'awesome.' Actual adhesive stamps.
Every good song needs a rhythm. Bureaucracy has rhythm. It's just very, very slow.
